plan.summary: Provision a containerized stream processing workload on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Autopilot with Workload Identity Federation, Pub/Sub subscription, Firestore metrics store, and an asyncio stream processing worker.
plan.architecture_overview: The architecture provisions a GKE Autopilot cluster within us-central1 running inside a dedicated VPC subnet. Workload Identity Federation binds the in-cluster Kubernetes Service Account ('sa-stream-worker' in namespace 'stream-apps') to a Google Cloud IAM Service Account with least-privilege roles for Pub/Sub pulling ('roles/pubsub.subscriber') and Firestore writing ('roles/datastore.user'). A Python asyncio worker deployment consumes batches of up to 50 events concurrently from 'stream-gke-sub', aggregates throughput, error rate, and latency over 1-minute tumbling windows, and persists time-series metrics into Firestore ('stream_metrics'). Autoscaling is managed via HorizontalPodAutoscaler targeting 80% CPU.

infra_tasks.title: Enable Required GCP APIs and Base Network Configuration
infra_tasks.description: Declare google_project_service for container.googleapis.com, pubsub.googleapis.com, firestore.googleapis.com, and artifactregistry.googleapis.com. Configure VPC and secondary IP ranges for GKE pods and services.
acceptance_criteria: Required GCP APIs declared with disable_on_destroy = false
VPC and subnets configured with container IP secondary ranges

infra_tasks.title: Provision GKE Autopilot Cluster, Artifact Registry, Pub/Sub, and Firestore
infra_tasks.description: Configure GKE Autopilot cluster with workload identity enabled, Artifact Registry Docker repository 'stream-workloads', Pub/Sub topic 'stream-ingest-topic', pull subscription 'stream-gke-sub', and Firestore native database.
acceptance_criteria: GKE cluster initialized in Autopilot mode
Artifact Registry Docker repository declared in us-central1
Pub/Sub topic and pull subscription created with max delivery attempts = 5
Firestore default database configured in Datastore/Native mode

infra_tasks.title: Configure Workload Identity Federation IAM Bindings
infra_tasks.description: Create GCP IAM Service Account bound to roles/pubsub.subscriber and roles/datastore.user. Establish roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser binding to k8s SA 'sa-stream-worker' in namespace 'stream-apps'.
acceptance_criteria: GCP SA created without static access keys
Workload Identity IAM binding maps stream-apps/sa-stream-worker to GCP SA
IAM least privilege enforced

infra_tasks.title: Synthesize Kubernetes Manifests and HorizontalPodAutoscaler
infra_tasks.description: Define declarative K8s manifests for Namespace 'stream-apps', annotated ServiceAccount 'sa-stream-worker', Deployment with 1 replica (cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi, liveness/readiness probes), and HPA targeting 80% CPU up to 2 replicas.
acceptance_criteria: All manifests adhere to standard Kubernetes v1 schemas
ServiceAccount contains gcp-service-account annotation
Deployment sets requests to 250m CPU and 512Mi memory
HPA configured to scale between 1 and 2 replicas at 80% CPU

code_tasks.title: Implement Asyncio Streaming Worker and Metrics Aggregator
code_tasks.description: Develop Python asyncio application using google-cloud-pubsub and google-cloud-firestore. Pull up to 50 events concurrently, aggregate 1-minute tumbling window metrics (throughput, error rate, latency), write summaries to Firestore collection 'stream_metrics', and provide HTTP liveness/readiness health probes on port 8080.
acceptance_criteria: Asyncio subscriber consumes messages from stream-gke-sub concurrently in batches of 50
Metrics aggregations correctly calculate 1-minute window metrics
Firestore client writes window records to 'stream_metrics'
Liveness and readiness health check endpoints return 200 OK

code_tasks.title: Implement Unit and Integration Tests with Mock Fixtures
code_tasks.description: Develop Pytest test suite mocking Pub/Sub streaming pull messages and Firestore batch client. Verify tumbling window math, error handling, message acking, and health probe responses.
acceptance_criteria: 100% test pass rate with pytest
Mock fixtures simulate message batches and verify window metric calculations
Zero Sev-1/Sev-2 security issues via static analysis
